title: 高通手机业务：不降反增13%，苹果流失影响何时兑现？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's start with Qualcomm here. It was a bigger move in the stock.
segments.zh: 先看高通，股价波动较大。

segments.en: Give us your reaction to just how this company is going to survive in an era of weaker demand for phones.
segments.zh: 在手机需求疲软时期，这家公司如何生存？

segments.en: I think that's a big question for Qualcomm. The story, if you go back a little bit, the story around Qualcomm for the last couple of years has been how are they going to diversify their product
segments.zh: 过去几年高通的故事一直是产品多元化。

segments.en: revenue to get into other areas beyond mobile. And as of today, they're still pretty reliant on mobile.
segments.zh: 但至今仍高度依赖手机业务。

segments.en: But the focus has really much been on cars, and IOT, and that data center.
segments.zh: 焦点转向汽车、物联网和数据中心。

segments.en: And I have to think that these quarters make me concerned that they have taken their eye off the core business.
segments.zh: 这些季度业绩让我担心他们忽视了核心业务。

segments.en: Mobile is a really challenging market right now. Memories, of course, big problems, eating demand.
segments.zh: 手机市场极具挑战，内存问题也抑制需求。

segments.en: But I look at these numbers and I think there's something else going on.
segments.zh: 但看这些数据，我觉得另有隐情。

segments.en: They're talking about losing even more share at Apple. I think they've taken their eye off the ball on mobile.
segments.zh: 他们提到在苹果份额进一步流失，我认为他们忽视了手机。

segments.en: Yeah, I didn't want to ask about that because the company did warn, it's losing business from Apple.
segments.zh: 公司确实警告正在失去苹果业务。

segments.en: More rapidly than anticipated. So is this about then needing to find new customers for that mobile chip business or just diversify more broadly?
segments.zh: 比预期更快。那么这是否意味着他们需要为移动芯片业务寻找新客户，还是更广泛地多元化？

segments.en: I think that's the root of the problem on mobile is that they told us a couple of years ago they were going to lose Apple by 2027.
segments.zh: 我认为移动业务问题的根源在于，几年前他们告诉我们将在2027年失去苹果。

segments.en: And now it looks like they're going to be out of Apple entirely by the end of this year.
segments.zh: 而现在看来，他们将在今年年底前完全失去苹果。

segments.en: So that's not good. So they've needed to diversify their customer base in mobile.
segments.zh: 这并不好。所以他们需要在移动领域多元化客户基础。
